name: @workspace.sh/react-native-jsoncanvas
description: React Native renderer for JSON Canvas (.canvas) documents. Skia + Reanimated, with pan / pinch / fit / recenter controls.

scripts.ios:prebuild: cd example/expo-app && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 npx expo prebuild --platform ios
scripts.ios:clear: cd example/expo-app && watchman watch-del-all && npx expo start --clear
scripts.ios:run: cd example/expo-app && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 npx expo run:ios
scripts.ios:run:device: cd example/expo-app && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 npx expo run:ios --device
scripts.ios:run:device:release: cd example/expo-app && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 npx expo run:ios --device --configuration Release
scripts.android:prebuild: cd example/expo-app && npx expo prebuild --platform android
scripts.android:clear: cd example/expo-app && watchman watch-del-all && npx expo start --clear
scripts.desktop:init: echo 'react-native-macos-init does not work cleanly inside npm workspaces. See example/macos-app/README.md for the one-time manual setup steps.' && exit 1
scripts.desktop:clear: cd example/macos-app && watchman watch-del-all && npx react-native start --port 8083 --reset-cache
